counterfactuals.reason: The proposed change mandates independent verification by a second person before proceeding with an irreversible action (wire transmission / concrete pour). This directly addresses the core failure mechanism: self-inspection with confirmation bias and no independent hold point. With independent verification required, the installing crew would no longer be checking their own rebar placement - a second person with fresh eyes and structural accountability would examine the work before the irreversible pour occurs. This eliminates both the confirmation bias (fresh perspective) and the absence of an independent hold point (mandatory second-party verification). The four-eyes principle breaks the self-inspection loop that allowed errors to pass through undetected.

The proposed change mandates independent verification by a party not involved in the initial data entry as a hold point before execution. In the wire transfer failure, the operator manually transcribes beneficiary account details and sends them without a second person checking them. If the proposed change were perfectly in place, a mandatory independent verifier (separate QC inspector equivalent - a second banking officer or compliance officer) would review the beneficiary account details before the wire transfer is authorized for transmission. This independent verification step would catch typing errors (transposition, omission, substitution of digits) or fraudulent substitution of account details before the transaction executes. The hold point prevents the wire transfer from being released until the independent party clears the verification, eliminating the single-point-of-failure where unverified manual transcription leads directly to irreversible transmission.

Typing errors (transposition, omission, substitution of digits) or fraudulent substitution of account details are not detected before transmission. The wire transfer protocol executes the transaction based on the entered data rather than the intended data. The error remains latent until the intended beneficiary reports non-receipt, by which time funds have settled in the wrong account and recovery is difficult or impossible.
left_mechanism_profile.repair: Require independent verification of entered beneficiary account details by a second person before wire transmission is authorized (four-eyes principle applied to data entry verification)

The schedule pressure further degrades inspection rigor as the crew is motivated to approve their own work to meet deadlines.
